hospitals.description: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia is the freestanding flagship of one of the largest pediatric systems in the country, sitting on Civic Center Boulevard in University City next to Penn Medicine and the University of Pennsylvania. It runs a Level I pediatric trauma center, a Level IV NICU of roughly 95 beds, a full pediatric ED and essentially every pediatric subspecialty, and it trains residents and fellows through Penn's Perelman School of Medicine. The campus keeps growing, with a research tower on Schuylkill Avenue, a 2024 behavioral health crisis center and a new inpatient tower planned for later in the decade. For an acute care PNP it is one of the biggest single employers of pediatric NPs on the East Coast, with inpatient, ICU, surgical and ED teams. The neighborhood is dense and urban, with most staff commuting from the city, the Main Line or South Jersey.
highlights: Consistently ranked among the top 10 U.S. News children's hospitals since 2009
Level I pediatric trauma center and Level IV NICU (about 95 NICU beds)
Penn Perelman teaching hospital with large residency and fellowship programs
Ranked No. 1 nationally in pediatric diabetes and endocrinology and orthopedics (2024-2025)
Second inpatient hospital in King of Prussia since 2022; satellite NICUs at partner hospitals
New 24-story main campus tower planned by about 2028

hospitals.description: CHOP's King of Prussia Hospital, branded the Middleman Family Pavilion, is the system's second inpatient children's hospital and opened in January 2022 off Goddard Boulevard in Montgomery County. The 250,000 square foot building has 52 private rooms split between 36 medical-surgical beds and a 16 bed PICU, plus a pediatric emergency department and a small surgical suite for orthopedic, plastic surgery and ENT cases needing an overnight stay. It connects to CHOP's existing specialty and urgent care center on the same campus. The suburban setting near the King of Prussia mall and the Turnpike makes it a very different commute from University City, and staff often rotate between the two hospitals. Shell space was built in for future growth.

hospitals.description: St. Christopher's Hospital for Children is a freestanding pediatric hospital at Erie Avenue and Front Street in North Philadelphia, serving one of the most Medicaid-dependent pediatric populations in the country. It holds Level I pediatric trauma status, runs a Level IV NICU and a pediatric burn center, and trains Drexel and Temple residents. Tower Health and Drexel bought it out of the Hahnemann bankruptcy in 2019 and run it as a joint venture; in 2026 Jefferson, Temple, PCOM and CHOP pledged a combined 30 million dollars to help keep it stable. Finances remain tight, and in 2026 it cut about 60 positions and ended its small kidney transplant program. For a PNP it offers high-acuity, safety-net pediatrics with a strong community health mission.

hospitals.description: Shriners Children's Philadelphia is a pediatric specialty hospital on North Broad Street, across from Temple University Hospital, focused on orthopedic conditions, spine deformity and spinal cord injury rehabilitation. It is part of the national Shriners Children's network, which treats children regardless of ability to pay. The hospital has inpatient beds for surgical and rehabilitation stays, and NPs typically work in orthopedic surgery, spinal cord injury and rehab teams rather than general acute care. It reportedly trains residents and fellows in partnership with Temple.
highlights: Pediatric orthopedic and spinal cord injury specialty hospital
Part of the national Shriners Children's network
About 53 licensed beds
North Broad Street location next to Temple's campus
hospitals.notes: Specialty fit: orthopedic and rehab NP roles rather than acute care. Bed count from Wikipedia PA list via scratch.

hospitals.description: KidsPeace operates a private psychiatric hospital for children and adolescents on its wooded campus in Orefield, northwest of Allentown in Lehigh County. The hospital provides acute inpatient psychiatric care alongside the organization's residential treatment and foster care programs. NP roles here lean toward psychiatric mental health practice, though pediatric NPs reportedly cover medical care for residents. It is about 20 minutes from Allentown and the Lehigh Valley hospitals.
highlights: Child and adolescent psychiatric hospital (about 120 beds)
Large private nonprofit children's behavioral health organization
Rural Lehigh County campus near Allentown
